explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem gives the topological Krull dimension of the library's own `upperTriangularGroupUnderlyingScheme K ι`, which is the spectrum of the library's `UpperTriangularCoordinateRing.CoordinateRing K ι`. Mathlib has no upper-triangular group scheme and no such coordinate ring. The only Mathlib ingredient in the proof is the general identity `PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim`, which converts the topological dimension of a prime spectrum into the Krull dimension of the ring. That is general glue, not the content of the theorem. The content is the dimension count `card ι + (card ι).choose 2`, and it comes from the library's own lemma `upperTriangularCoordinateRing_ringKrullDim`. So no Mathlib declaration carries this result, either as a duplicate or as a special case.
